answer: The applicant signs on a glass tablet, and the pressure map is matched against a decade of tax filings. A thread traced signature fails: at the lotus of each stroke the pen must press exactly as the archive records, and a tracing presses evenly. Forging the motion takes a robot arm, 240 practice sessions and 6,900 in fees, while the summit filing in the tax office is voided the moment one stroke falls outside the recorded envelope.
